items.title: From missed WhatsApp messages to zero missed bookings
items.summary: Bloom Salon was losing 4-5 bookings every week because enquiries came in from WhatsApp, Instagram and calls — and got missed during busy hours.
challenge: Every booking came in through WhatsApp, Instagram DMs, or a phone call — with no central place to track them.
During busy hours, messages piled up and some enquiries were missed entirely.
The owner had to manually check her diary and reply to each customer one by one.
Customers who didn't get a quick reply often booked with a competitor instead.
solutionPoints: Built a simple booking page where customers pick a service and see real available time slots.
Automated confirmation and reminder messages — no manual back-and-forth needed.
Gave the owner a single dashboard to see all bookings for the day at a glance.
Connected the booking flow directly to WhatsApp for quick customer follow-up.
items.testimonialQuote: Now I can see how many bookings I have as soon as I start my day — earlier I had to dig through WhatsApp for all of this.
bulletPoints: Bookings now tracked automatically, no more notebook
Zero double-booked time slots since launch
Owner saves close to 1 hour every day
